verdict.rationale: Trello's own support docs list a built-in AI feature to help write or edit content, so the product does ship an in-product AI aid. It is evidenced only as a single thin mention scoped to writing assistance, not general task delegation. The MCP server (for external AI tools) and non-AI automation are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks (e.g., creating or organizing cards and boards), detailed first-party docs on the AI assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI to help write or edit content
